id: 13_RCCB RCD Ratings of RCCB Residual Current Sensitivity RCCB 30mA 100mA HSE STUDY
title: 漏电保护器的灵敏度档位（国内版）
source_doc: course/Electrical Safety Series/13_RCCB RCD Ratings of RCCB Residual Current Sensitivity RCCB 30mA 100mA HSE STUDY.md
author_source: project/Electrical Safety Series/13_RCCB RCD Ratings of RCCB Residual Current Sensitivity RCCB 30mA 100mA HSE STUDY（国内版）/src.py

points.K6: 防人身触电，选最灵敏的
points.K8: 大档位只管防火和设备
points.S1: 看懂铭牌上的两个参数
points.S4: 新增大功率仪器先申报

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验楼走廊的配电箱旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a closed wall-mounted electrical distribution box in a bright university lab corridor and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 你好！今天聊聊漏电保护器的档位。
overlay: 漏电保护器的灵敏度档位

shots.scene: 漏电保护器图标旁，一个刻度盘从小指到大
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a residual current breaker module next to a dial gauge whose needle sweeps from low to high. No people.
shots.narration: 同样是漏电保护，灵敏度可不一样。

shots.scene: 老李打开配电箱，阿杰在旁边好奇地看着一排模块
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer opens a distribution box, and the young male student looks curiously at a row of blank breaker modules inside.
shots.narration: 老李检修配电箱，阿杰凑过来看。

shots.scene: 阿杰指着两个外形相似、标签空白的模块
shots.prompt_en: The young male student points at two similar-looking breaker modules with blank labels.
shots.narration: “这两个长得一样，有什么不同？”

shots.scene: 老李笑着把欣欣请到箱前
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer smiles and gestures toward the panda mascot, who walks up to the box.
shots.narration: 老李说：区别就在灵敏度上。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一个空白标签的漏电保护器模型
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a model of a residual current breaker module with a blank label and a small test button.
shots.narration: 先认识它：剩余电流保护器。

shots.scene: 一个模块图标，周围出现三个空白名牌，用箭头连到同一个模块
shots.prompt_en: Three blank name tags with arrows all pointing to the same breaker module icon. No people.
shots.narration: 俗称漏电保护器，指的是同一类东西。

shots.scene: 电线剖面：相线电流流进，中性线电流流回，两边箭头一样长
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of two wires: an arrow of current going out on one wire and an equal arrow returning on the other wire. No people.
shots.narration: 正常时，电流去多少，就回多少。

shots.scene: 一小股电流从设备外壳漏向地面，箭头变红
shots.prompt_en: A small red arrow of current leaks from the metal case of an instrument down to a ground symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 有电流漏到地里，就出现了差值。

shots.scene: 模块开关啪地跳下，后面的线路变暗
shots.prompt_en: The breaker module lever snaps down to off and the circuit behind it goes dark. No people.
shots.narration: 它一发现漏电，就立刻断开电路。

shots.scene: 人形图标的手碰到裸露带电导线，闪电符号
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram whose hand touches a bare live wire, with a lightning bolt symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 手直接碰到带电部分，最危险。

shots.scene: 电流经人形图标流向地面，模块随即跳闸，人形周围出现盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Current flows through a person pictogram to the ground, the breaker module trips at once, and a shield appears around the pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 漏电保护器能快速切断电源。

shots.scene: 盾牌图标护住心脏图标
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon protecting a heart icon. No people.
shots.narration: 把触电伤害降到最低，保住性命。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着一排从小到大排列的刻度格
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a row of blank scale blocks arranged from small to large.
shots.narration: 它的额定值，叫剩余电流灵敏度。

shots.scene: 六个大小递增的空白模块图标排成一排
shots.prompt_en: Six blank breaker module icons in a row, each slightly larger than the one before. No people.
shots.narration: 从很灵敏到不太灵敏，有好几档。

shots.scene: 刻度盘指针在小的一端，旁边一个很小的漏电箭头就让开关跳下
shots.prompt_en: A dial needle at the low end, and a tiny leakage arrow is enough to make the breaker lever drop. No people.
shots.narration: 档位越小，越小的漏电就会跳闸。

shots.scene: 三个模块分别连到人形、房屋火焰、机器三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three breaker module icons, each linked by a line to a different icon: a person pictogram, a house with a flame and a machine. No people.
shots.narration: 不同档位，保护的对象不同。

shots.scene: 小研拿着空白清单，对着三个图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a blank checklist and ticks beside three icons on a board.
shots.narration: 先想清楚保护谁，再选档位。

shots.section_title: 防人身触电，选最灵敏的
shots.scene: 人形图标旁的模块，刻度盘指针在最灵敏一端
shots.prompt_en: A breaker module next to a person pictogram, with a dial needle at the most sensitive end. No people.
shots.narration: 要防人身触电，选最灵敏的那档。
overlay: 防人身触电，选最灵敏的

shots.section_title: 防人身触电，选最灵敏的
shots.scene: 实验室插座回路、水浴锅、手持电钻三个图标，各有一个小盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Three icons each with a small shield: a row of lab bench sockets, a water bath and a handheld drill. No people.
shots.narration: 插座、用水设备、手持工具都靠它。

shots.section_title: 防人身触电，选最灵敏的
shots.scene: 空白的标准手册图标
shots.prompt_en: A closed standards handbook with a blank cover. No people.
shots.narration: 具体数值以现行标准和学校规定为准。

shots.scene: 刻度盘指针往大的一端挪了一格
shots.prompt_en: A dial needle moves one step toward the high end. No people.
shots.narration: 灵敏度低一档，也还能挡一部分电击。

shots.scene: 盾牌图标有一半变淡
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon with half of it faded. No people.
shots.narration: 但保护打了折扣。

shots.scene: 老李看着空白图纸，摇头后又点头
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer studies a blank wiring drawing, first shaking his head and then nodding reluctantly.
shots.narration: 只有用不了最灵敏的，才考虑它。

shots.section_title: 大档位只管防火和设备
shots.scene: 刻度盘指针在大的一端，旁边是房屋火焰和机器图标
shots.prompt_en: A dial needle at the high end, next to icons of a house with a flame and a machine. No people.
shots.narration: 大档位，是用来防电气火灾的。
overlay: 大档位只管防火和设备

shots.section_title: 大档位只管防火和设备
shots.scene: 电缆老化处缓慢漏电，模块跳闸，火苗图标熄灭
shots.prompt_en: Slow leakage at an aged cable section, the breaker module trips, and a small flame icon goes out. No people.
shots.narration: 线路长期漏电发热，它能及早切断。

shots.section_title: 大档位只管防火和设备
shots.scene: 大档位模块护着人形图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A high-range breaker module placed in front of a person pictogram, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 它绝不能当作防触电的保护。

shots.section_title: 大档位只管防火和设备
shots.scene: 两个模块上下排列：上面防火档，下面高灵敏度档
shots.prompt_en: Two breaker module icons stacked: an upper one marked with a flame icon and a lower one marked with a person icon. No people.
shots.narration: 防火和防触电，各司其职。

shots.section_title: 看懂铭牌上的两个参数
shots.scene: 欣欣拿着放大镜看模块侧面的空白铭牌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot looks through a magnifying glass at the blank nameplate on the side of a breaker module.
shots.narration: 铭牌上有两个参数，别看混了。
overlay: 看懂铭牌上的两个参数

shots.section_title: 看懂铭牌上的两个参数
shots.scene: 粗管道图标与细针图标并排
shots.prompt_en: A thick pipe icon next to a thin needle icon. No people.
shots.narration: 一个是能通过多大的工作电流，

shots.section_title: 看懂铭牌上的两个参数
shots.scene: 细针图标与小闪电图标
shots.prompt_en: A thin needle icon next to a small lightning bolt icon. No people.
shots.narration: 一个是多小的漏电就会跳。

shots.section_title: 看懂铭牌上的两个参数
shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，又露出明白的表情
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head, then nods with an understanding smile.
shots.narration: 数字大的是承载，小的是灵敏度。

shots.scene: 模块旁的插线板插满大功率电器，线缆发红
shots.prompt_en: A power strip next to a breaker module is crowded with high-power appliances and its cable glows red. No people.
shots.narration: 只管漏电的保护器，不管过载。

shots.scene: 两根导线碰在一起冒火花的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two wires touching each other with sparks. No people.
shots.narration: 短路时，也要靠断路器来切断。

shots.scene: 漏电保护器和断路器两个模块并排，各打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Two modules side by side, a residual current breaker and a circuit breaker, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 两种保护配合，线路才安全。

shots.scene: 小研站在实验室门口的配电箱前，箱前通道空着
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands in front of a distribution box near the lab door, and the floor in front of it is clear.
shots.narration: 进实验室，先找到配电箱的位置。

shots.scene: 配电箱前堆着纸箱的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of cardboard boxes piled in front of a distribution box, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 箱前不堆杂物，箱门保持关好。

shots.scene: 紧急时小研拉下总开关的手部特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the female graduate student's hand pulling down the main switch lever in an emergency.
shots.narration: 出现险情，能第一时间断电。

shots.section_title: 新增大功率仪器先申报
shots.scene: 阿杰抱着一台新仪器，准备插到普通插座上，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student carries a new instrument toward an ordinary wall socket, and the scene is marked with a red X.
shots.narration: 新到大功率仪器，别急着插电。
overlay: 新增大功率仪器先申报

shots.section_title: 新增大功率仪器先申报
shots.scene: 阿杰把空白申请表交给王老师
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hands a blank request form to the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 先报告负责人，向学校申报。

shots.section_title: 新增大功率仪器先申报
shots.scene: 老李核对空白图纸，在配电箱里换上新模块
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks a blank wiring drawing and fits a new module in the distribution box.
shots.narration: 由持证电工核算线路、配好保护。

shots.section_title: 新增大功率仪器先申报
shots.scene: 学生自己拆换模块、调换档位的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand swapping a breaker module by itself, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 学生不得自行更换或调换档位。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在配电箱旁，身后是刻度盘图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the distribution box with a dial gauge icon behind.
shots.narration: 漏电保护器，发现漏电就断开。

shots.scene: 人形图标配最灵敏档，房屋火焰配大档位
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram paired with a sensitive breaker icon, and a house with a flame paired with a high-range breaker icon. No people.
shots.narration: 防触电用高灵敏，大档位只管防火。

shots.scene: 铭牌、断路器、配电箱、申请表四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a nameplate, a circuit breaker, a distribution box and a request form. No people.
shots.narration: 看懂铭牌，配合断路器，先申报。

shots.scene: 欣欣、老李和阿杰在配电箱前一起向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the facility engineer and the young male student wave goodbye at the camera in front of the closed distribution box.
shots.narration: 选对档位，安全用电，下次见！
